certification_boundary: This waterfall remains a blocker map. Rev0364 adds reporting data routes, but does not certify because final forms, actual filings, public disclosure, public-liquidity terms, and recovery instruments are absent.

waterfall_claimants.current_bound: legitimate public-interest lane only if issuer/platform upside is not protected
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: legal priority and continuity terms under issuer/wallet/custodian failure

waterfall_claimants.claimant: stablecoin holders with reserve-backed redemption claims
waterfall_claimants.current_bound: 1:1 reserve law supports a redemption claim perimeter
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: timing, valuation, custody, receivership, and haircut rules

waterfall_claimants.current_bound: private first-loss class; no statutory federal guarantee or insurance representation
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: whether supervisory or market-functioning actions preserve private rents

waterfall_claimants.claimant: dealers, repo counterparties, MMFs, Treasury-market liquidity
waterfall_claimants.current_bound: reserve assets and market scale create a market-functioning channel
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: fire-sale path, facility trigger, collateral terms, penalty rates

waterfall_claimants.claimant: public liquidity authorities and future fiscal capacity
waterfall_claimants.current_bound: residual support surface if payment/market stability is threatened
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: who bears losses and whether support has a sunset/reporting condition

waterfall_claimants.current_bound: missing instrument; no identified warrant/clawback/senior fee term
waterfall_claimants.open_blocker: public fees, penalties, clawbacks, warrants, senior claims, or equivalent recovery terms

rev0364_reporting_data_cutover: OCC PS-01/PS-02 and FDIC proposed-rule sources give concrete evidence fields for the waterfall, but no actual issuer filings or public-upside instrument yet.
